Mr. DD a supplier of goods, pays GST under regular scheme. The amount of input tax credit (ITC) available and output tax liability under different tax heads for a tax period are as under: -

| Head | Output tax liability (₹) | ITC available (₹) |
| :--- | :---: | :---: |
| CGST | 60,500 | 68,000 |
| SGST/ UTGST | 60,500 | 49,000 |
| IGST | 60,500 | 75,000 |

Compute the minimum net GST payable in cash by Mr. DD and also closing balance of ITC of each head.
